We are delighted to share that CRISIL has upgraded our credit rating to AAA with a stable 
outlook. With this upgrade, we are now AAA by all 4 leading domestic rating agencies: CRISIL, 
ICRA, CARE Rating, and India Rating. This achievement reflects the strength of our balance 
sheet, prudent risk management, strong asset quality and the consistency of our operating 
performance. 
 
Before discussing our operational performance for the quarter, Let me begin by sharing some 
perspective on the industry environment and the key trends shaping the housing finance sector. 
The recent 25 bps reported hike by RBI and clear policy guidance reinforce confidence in the 
housing finance sector's medium-term prospects. 
 
While broader macroeconomic developments may influence growth trends periodically, the 
sector continues to benefit from strong structural drivers including urbanization, improving

infrastructure, rising incomes, favorable demographics and increasing homeownership 
aspirations. These factors continue to support resilient housing demand and healthy growth. 
 
Industry prospects also remain encouraging. ICRA expects affordable housing finance companies 
to deliver AUM growth of 19%-21% in FY27 supported by robust demand, expanding 
distribution reach, and the significant opportunity presented by India's underpenetrated housing 
finance market.  
Coming to PNB Housing Finance Q2 FY27 was a landmark quarter for the company. Some of 
the key highlights for the quarter are as follows. 
 
Overall disbursement grew 60% YoY to INR 9,609 crores. This includes pool buyout of INR 838 
crores. 
Retail disbursements reached an all-time high of INR 9,250 crores, registering a growth of 54% 
YoY. 
Loan book grew by 19% YOY, in line with our guidance, led by strong disbursements.  
GNPA improved to 0.91% vs 0.95% in Q1 FY27.  
Spread improved to 2.43% as 2.12% in Q1 FY27.  
ROA and ROE improved to 2.53% and 12.33% respectively.  
At segment level, the affordable business witnessed a strong revival following the strategic 
initiative undertaken over the past few quarter, with disbursal growth of 40% YoY to INR1,149 
crores.  
The emerging market business delivered another strong quarter with disbursement growing 36% 
YoY to INR 2,882 crores. 
 
Our prime business continued its steady momentum with disbursement reaching INR4,380 
crores, up by 44% YoY. 
Corporate disbursement stood at INR 360 crores for Q2 FY 27 versus INR 215 crores in Q1 
FY27.  
This translated to an overall loan book of INR 95,079 crores as on 30th September '26, 
representing growth of 19% YoY. 
 
Our retail loan portfolio also grew by 19% YoY to INR 94,391 crores. Within retail portfolio, the 
affordable and emerging markets segment continued to be our key growth engines, representing 
YoY book growth of 45% and 22% respectively, and together contributing 41% of overall retail 
portfolio. 
 
We remained on track to increase this contribution to 45% by the end of FY 26-27. Let me also 
update you all on our strategic initiatives that we highlighted during Q1 earning call. We

Under PMAY, we undertook an extensive awareness campaign through PMAY Yatra across key 
markets in Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, and Uttar Pradesh. 
These initiatives have helped thousands of families better understand the benefits of scheme and 
navigate their home ownership journey with greater ease. We further strengthen our affordable 
housing outreach through the inauguration of India's first PMAY nodal branch in Siliguri and 
Kanpur. Till date, we have facilitated benefit for over 8,000 PMAY Urban 2.0 beneficiaries, with 
another 1,200 applications submitted to NHB for approval. 
 
Going forward, we intend to scale the impact of this initiative through our extensive network of 
more than 400 branches across India.  
The corporate loan book stood at INR 689 crores as on 30th September 2026.  
During the quarter, we successfully completed Voice AI POC for Bucket X calling with very 
promising results. We also completed POCs for AI-powered policy and knowledge assistance, as 
well as intelligent document processing, where AI helped in classification, summarization, cross-
validation, and extraction/population of data. Apart from core business functions, we also 
successfully completed agentic AI POC for our employee hiring. 
 
The next couple of quarters will now be focused upon translating these successful POCs into 
production deployment and redefining our customer journey by leveraging GenAI and Agentic 
AI across various functions. On traditional AI front, we continue to strengthen our robust machine 
learning ecosystem. We have developed an end-to-end collection solution suite, right from early 
warning system to signal to bounce prediction to settlement prediction and prioritization. The 
solution suite covers the entire collection lifecycle.  
As far as geographical presence is concerned, our distribution network stood at 404 branches 
across India as on 30th September '26, which include 234 Affordable branches which we call 
Roshni, 88 Emerging Market branches, and 81 Prime branches. The extensive reach gives us a 
strong foothold in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets where we continue to witness significant growth 
opportunities and strong customer demand.  
Asset quality continues to strengthen during the quarter, with GNPA improving to 0.91% as 
compared to 0.95% during Q1 FY27. During Q2 FY27, we recovered INR 75 crores from the 
written-off pool, resulting in a negative credit cost of 19 bps. Our retail written-off pool has now 
reduced to approximately INR 320 crores, reflecting sustained progress in recoveries and 
portfolio cleanup efforts.

and create long-term value for all stakeholders.

capital base, healthy asset quality, and improving profitability, we are confident in our ability to 
deliver sustainable growth and long-term value creation.
